description: This Java class 'VisitVoidHandler' handles the voiding process for Visit objects in the OpenMRS framework. It ensures that when a Visit is voided, all associated Encounter objects are also voided, maintaining data consistency within patient visit records.

classes.name: VisitVoidHandler
classes.description: A handler class for voiding Visit objects and associated Encounters in OpenMRS.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Void the Visit and all its related Encounter objects by setting their voided date and reason.
